reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) strongly supports the fluorine effect on TiAl intermetallics, but the hypothesis extends this to RHEAs without any cited evidence for such alloys. The key premise of transferability to complex RHEA microstructures is unsupported by the provided passages.
